versions.changelog:
Initial release of automated faceless YouTube content pipeline.

- Generates scripts for trading updates, news summaries, and educational content using templates
- Converts scripts to speech with ElevenLabs API (TTS)
- Assembles videos with ffmpeg, including background visuals
- Outputs ready-to-upload video files along with scripts and YouTube metadata
- Supports batch processing and multiple input types (e.g., trading data, custom scripts)
- Requires ELEVENLABS_API_KEY environment variable for TTS and has external API and ffmpeg dependencies
